head: f63a5521d0bd24fea490b91d1056ea5d6491bd8d
changed_scope: PR adds one learner, README and raw author evidence; no scorer, runner, dataset or leaderboard changes.
method: Eight RMSNorm/ReLU MLPs trained with Muon, tangent jitter, mixup and disjoint-pool pseudo-label cross-teaching; signed-power current-draw embeddings and clamped train/query graph propagation.
state_reset: classify copies all supplied data through _load, recomputes same-class tangents, then _reset overwrites all model parameters, copies fresh weights into EMA, clears Muon and Adam state, timestep and pseudo-label/confidence arrays and reconstructs disjoint query pools before 2200 updates. Module _S caches compiler/CUDA graph/workspace only; no learned warmup state is retained for fitting.
inputs_and_truth: Supplied tensors are copied into owned buffers and never mutated. Query supervision derives from current model probabilities, provided train labels and the current unlabeled query graph; no test truth, scorer, caller state or hidden dataset access.
cross_teaching: Half 0 trains pseudo-labels on pool 0 and half 1 on disjoint pool 1. Each half labels the other half, using embeddings/logits rather than the pseudo-label arrays. Transductive query features are allowed by existing accepted D3/D5 sources.
prior_or_harness_shortcut: Only scalar algorithm hyperparameters and docstrings. No fitted literals, encoded weights, decoder, external data, network calls, timer/event patching, parent introspection, or data-specific work shortcut. os usage is getuid plus runtime setdefault cache paths under /tmp.
work_and_compilation: Warmup builds torch.compile loss/update functions, captures labelled and pseudo steps after three setup executions each and synchronizes streams. Every timed call includes tangent fitting, reset, fixed 2200 graph replays, scheduled cross-teaching and final readout.
source_specific: Width 128; inputs copy into first 60 of 64 zeroed columns. Four padding columns stay zero in current-data tangent and gradient computations. Hidden biases plus head use a compiled explicit AdamW whose moments reset. Final graph readout uses the middle and last hidden embeddings and 10 neighbors.
qualification_scope: Manual full-source audit, unchanged canonical check_source/review_flags, independent raw-record arithmetic and one frozen fresh energy-enabled three-run Modal qualification. Author verification code is not executed.

policy_assessment.canonical_rules: mnist.py docstring defines each run (11 MNIST + 4 holdout), D5 accuracy<=1.90%, worst draw<=3.40%, foreign accuracy>=15%, clock and dispersion gates. run_modal.py --runs 3 reports a complete pass only if all three runs pass; established rows use median of three.
policy_assessment.rerun_rule_search: Current canonical README, scorer docstring, runner and root CLAUDE.md contain no rule permanently barring a source after a failed earlier complete author set, and no pooled-across-all-sets eligibility rule for this separate mnist-a100 runner. Historical maintainer reviews avoided replacing failed reviewer runs; this review will retain its initial reviewer set without replacements.
policy_assessment.earlier_author_failure: First author set of this same source passed 2/3; failed run 3 has 107909/110000 correct against 107910 required. It remains a failed set. Later author 3/3 does not rewrite that outcome, but published rules do not explicitly make the source permanently ineligible. Independent set is evaluated separately and retained regardless of outcome.

randomness_note: The dedicated initialization generator is reseeded. Global/graph RNG stream positions used for minibatches and jitter can continue from warmup, but no fitted data, weights or optimizer state persists; canonical rules require fresh fitting, not identical random stream positions.
author_evidence_scope: Author raw JSON is supplied evidence reconstructed numerically; it is not attested independent execution. The separately launched reviewer set is independent GPU reproduction.
